notes: REVERSAL: Marcus first decides live streaming with a thirty-second refresh ('Let's say the data refreshes every thirty seconds. Streaming.'), and later in the same meeting withdraws it in favour of hourly. Only the final position is labeled, as T1-R04. An extraction that reports a thirty-second or streaming refresh requirement is WRONG, not merely imprecise - it reports a decision that was reversed in the same document. T1-Q03 is a missing_nfr and therefore has an EMPTY quotes array by definition: a category the sources never covered has no span to cite. Strangers matching by span overlap (ADR 0008) must skip span matching for missing_nfr items and match them by category instead. Dana joins at 10:22 and four requirements (T1-R06, R07, R08 and, via her echo, R14) come from her, so a system that gives up on late-joiner content loses a third of this document. T1-R09 and T1-R10 are two distinct requirements stated inside one exchange (Tom's 'the same two things'); an extractor that emits them as a single 'security' requirement is one match plus one miss, not a match. AMENDED 2026-09-02 after Vaibhav's label review (E1-S3 Part 2). T1-R15 was ADDED: the forty-one million row figure is a constraint the two-second budget is meaningless without, and the extractor had been emitting it as an unlabelled requirement and being scored as inventing it. The addition was made after seeing extraction output and is recorded as such in evals/results/README.md; the justification is on the transcript's own terms, not the model's. The statement stops short of asserting pre-aggregation as the chosen route, because that sentence is interrupted mid-word and never resumed - asserting it would be the same error as reporting the reversed thirty-second refresh. T1-R05, the Q4 pilot date, was KEPT after Vaibhav confirmed a fixed date belongs in the PRD, so the four consecutive runs that missed it remain a real extraction miss and not a labelling error; his point that a date belongs in prioritisation is carried to E3-S3. Nothing was removed and no existing statement was reworded.
